title: About Me
subtitle: A little bit about who I am
paragraph1: I am a senior Software Engineering student at Izmir University of Economics. Highly adaptable to emerging technologies, I actively build projects that integrate machine learning models into edge devices and develop autonomous systems focused on environmental sustainability.
paragraph2: I am an analytical problem solver, highly proficient in Agile/Scrum methodologies, and a strong collaborative team player. When I'm not coding, you can find me skiing, playing the guitar, or reading.
